asked.item: Can Blotato automatically repost CEO's posts with native LinkedIn Repost to the company Page

verdict.reason: The Reposting sentences say LinkedIn's API does not support reposting an existing post, so Blotato cannot do it, and they give the manual option.

steps.text: No. LinkedIn's API does not support reposting an existing LinkedIn post, so Blotato can't do it.
To repost, open LinkedIn manually and click Repost on the post.
